address: 332 Springvale Rd, Great Falls, VA 22066, USA
bio: L’Auberge Chez François, tucked away in the rolling hills of Great Falls, Virginia, has long stood as one of the Washington, D.C. area’s most celebrated fine-dining destinations. Founded in 1976 by the late Chef François Haeringer and now led by his son Chef Jacques Haeringer, the restaurant carries on a proud Alsatian tradition, blending classic French technique with an emphasis on local, seasonal ingredients. The charming chalet-style dining room, adorned with wood beams, fresh flowers, and rustic accents, creates an atmosphere of warmth and old-world hospitality, making it a popular setting for both everyday celebrations and once-in-a-lifetime occasions. The multi-course menus highlight French classics such as escargots, beef tenderloin, and the house’s legendary soufflés, each dish prepared with precision and a dedication to tradition. A robust wine program showcases both French and Virginian selections, curated to elevate every course. Over the decades, L’Auberge Chez François has earned numerous accolades for its cuisine, service, and sustainability practices, consistently ranking among the top restaurants in the region. With its seamless marriage of French culinary heritage, refined presentation, and familial warmth, it remains a destination for those seeking one of the most timeless and memorable dining experiences near the nation’s capital.
